idea: A dog-walking app for busy Madrid professionals, €12 a walk

brand.name: Ronda
brand.voice: Friendly, reliable, local, plain. Write like the walker texting the owner.

candidates.construction: Ink ring, radius 22, stroke 8, centred. Accent disc radius 7 sits on the ring at upper right (47.5,16.5), like a walker on the loop.
candidates.idea: A round route with one walker on it: the same loop, every day.
candidates.svg: <circle cx="32" cy="32" r="22" fill="none" stroke="#1F3A2E" stroke-width="8"/><circle cx="47.5" cy="16.5" r="7" fill="#E07A3F"/>

candidates.construction: Five ink bars, 8 wide, 40 tall, on a 10 pitch from x=8. One accent band 8 high crosses all five at midday, y=28 to 36.
candidates.idea: Five weekdays, one midday walk cutting through every one.
candidates.svg: <rect x="8" y="12" width="8" height="40" fill="#1F3A2E"/><rect x="20" y="12" width="8" height="40" fill="#1F3A2E"/><rect x="32" y="12" width="8" height="40" fill="#1F3A2E"/><rect x="44" y="12" width="8" height="40" fill="#1F3A2E"/><rect x="4" y="28" width="56" height="8" fill="#E07A3F"/>

candidates.construction: Ink stem 10x44 at x=14. Bowl is a half ring: stroked path radius 11, weight 10. Accent diagonal leg as a polygon, a stepping stride.
candidates.idea: An R whose leg is mid-stride: your walker coming through the door.
candidates.svg: <rect x="14" y="10" width="10" height="44" fill="#1F3A2E"/><path d="M24 15H32A11 11 0 0 1 32 37H24" fill="none" stroke="#1F3A2E" stroke-width="10"/><polygon points="28,42 40,42 54,54 42,54" fill="#E07A3F"/>

candidates.construction: Ink stem 10x44 at x=10. Bowl is a full ring, centre (38,26), radius 14, stroke 9. Accent diagonal leg stroked 9 from (34,42) to (52,55).
candidates.idea: An R with a round bowl, the ronda loop, and a walking leg.
candidates.svg: <rect x="10" y="10" width="10" height="44" fill="#1F3A2E"/><circle cx="38" cy="26" r="14" fill="none" stroke="#1F3A2E" stroke-width="9"/><line x1="34" y1="42" x2="52" y2="55" stroke="#E07A3F" stroke-width="9"/>

candidates.construction: Ink disc radius 26 centred. A background ring, radius 14 and stroke 4, is cut into it as a track. Accent disc radius 6 sits on the track at top.
candidates.idea: A circuit track with one runner on it: same route, same walker.
candidates.svg: <circle cx="32" cy="32" r="26" fill="#1F3A2E"/><circle cx="32" cy="32" r="14" fill="none" stroke="#F5F1E8" stroke-width="4"/><circle cx="32" cy="18" r="6" fill="#E07A3F"/>

candidates.construction: Circle radius 24 split into two half discs with a 6 gap at y=32. Lower half is ink, upper half is accent, as the midday sun.
candidates.idea: A day split in two, with midday as the sun-coloured half.
